notes.title: New version uploaded by popular demand
notes.notes:
By popular demand, this version removes the inverted axis vertical controls and the Lobby that seemed to be confusing players on what to do next.
Thanks to the guys at  some of the youtube channels for the more than 165K views and taking the time to go over laughable areas of the game and show how crappy it was (really?), but the take away here is that they really got into it and did an in-depth review of the game, this is the way it should be.
To be fair, inverted controls is the default for 3rd person games and it's the natural way, but for the whiners up there, they're now NON-inverted.  A new update will be coming soon with an option to switch between the two.
Another fix is that walking zombies on the train tracks are killed instantly by moving trains;  so far, this has been implemented in the main subway station which is the one where you find yourself first.

notes.title: Reverting back to original version approved by Steam
notes.notes:
I have to apologize for recent patches that have made the game unplayable as reviewed by one of the curators.   For people that have purchase the game and have found it unplayable, I'm uploading the original version.
The idea will be to keep Next Stop Zombie as it was and create a new game within a few months with the intended new features of multi-player, achievement and leader-board in a completely different game.
If you have purchased the game, you can send us an email saying you're a current owner and we will send you keys for the future game free of charge.
Thanks.
TF

notes.title: New update to allow non 64-bit version
notes.notes:
This patch allows you to run without the 64-bit limitation that was introduced by mistake.

Please uninstall the older version as follows:  

1) Go to the Steam platform (not the game itself).

2) Right-click on the game 'Next Stop Zombie' and choose Uninstall from the menu.

3) Reinstall the game again.

notes.title: Version 1.11 as of January 12th, 2018
notes.notes: This version adds faster action and movement to players, zombies and other enemies and at the same time uses a HD camera for the player for better visualization and enjoyment; this version also has more information on how to get out of they Hyperloop Mover and finally, this version also fixes some bugs like getting hit by an invisible enemy as seen in some videos uploaded by other players when they were using older versions.

notes.title: Announcing new version 1.6: Hyperloops, improved cameras and gameplay and patches.
notes.notes:
Improvements and Patches:
Created outside and inside Hyperloops to connect different areas within the maps and to make it easier to get to.  Three different birdview cameras depending on the location are available with zoom/right click.  Continued improvement on the main camera to get a better resolution. 
Fixed ethereal figures weapons so that they inflict damage on the player.
Circular area visible within birdview cameras so that player knows where to go to avoid radiation.  Radiation now affects health meter and will not kill the player but instead will turned the player into a zombie.
Ability for the player to run and crouch where as before player only walked and jumped. 
Added loot locations inside some of the trains so that ammo is available after running out.
